findings.title: Drive metadata sidecar update is untested
findings.description: The change adds both an existing-sidecar update path and a missing-sidecar creation path after a successful Drive upload, but there are no tests for google_drive.rs. The pipeline tests only cover initial sidecar creation; they do not catch regressions where upload loses existing voice metadata, writes the wrong share URL or timestamp, or fails to create the sidecar for an older recording. A focused test around the metadata update branches would guard this new persisted contract.

findings.quote:
/// Scan the output directory for recordings and return metadata for each.
/// Scan a directory for .mp4 recordings and return metadata.
findings.title: Comment repeats code: duplicate scan doc comments
findings.description: These consecutive doc comments describe the same behavior in slightly different words and add no separate constraint or rationale. Keep one accurate summary so future edits have a single comment to maintain.

findings.title: Recording output fallback policy is duplicated
findings.description: The library now owns a second output-directory resolver, while `pipeline::process_recording` separately applies the fallback when creating the configured directory fails. These policies already differ: this helper treats any existing configured path as usable, whereas the pipeline switches to the fallback on a create failure. In that case recordings are saved under the fallback but the Library scans the configured path, and future changes to fallback behavior must be coordinated in both modules. Move output-directory resolution to one shared helper used by both callers.

findings.title: Deletion command has no behavioral test
findings.description: The added Rust tests cover the path validator in isolation and directory scanning, but none invoke delete_recording to verify the recording and its companion metadata, transcript, and cached thumbnail are removed, or that an outside path leaves files untouched. A regression in this destructive Library action can therefore pass the suite while deleting the wrong set of files or leaving stale sidecars behind.

findings.quote: const bytes = await tauriInvoke<number[]>('read_file_bytes', { path: thumbPath });
findings.title: Custom output folders leave every thumbnail blank
findings.description: When a user saves recordings to a custom folder outside the temp, Videos, and ~/VoiceOver allowlist, generate_thumbnail successfully writes the JPEG under that folder, but read_file_bytes rejects it. The catch leaves the card on its placeholder, so thumbnails fail for supported custom save locations.

findings.quote:
const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(bytes)], { type: 'image/jpeg' });
			thumbnailUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
findings.title: Revoke thumbnail object URLs when cards are destroyed
findings.description: Every visible recording card creates a blob URL for its thumbnail, but the component cleanup only disconnects the IntersectionObserver and never calls URL.revokeObjectURL. Navigating away from and back to the Library leaves each generated URL and its image data retained for the lifetime of the webview, so repeatedly browsing a large library can grow memory use without bound.

findings.title: Library sorting has no unit coverage
findings.description: Sorting by date, size, and name with both directions is new behavior in the Library state, but the available frontend tests do not cover libraryState or its derived sorted list. A focused test with deliberately unordered recordings would catch direction inversions, a comparator using the wrong field, and mutation of the original recording order before users rely on sorting to find past recordings.

findings.title: Leaving Settings drops unsaved changes
findings.description: Changing the save location (and other settings that only mutate appState) now updates memory without persisting it: the old Settings back action called saveConfig, but this sidebar route has no save action on navigation. After restarting, the app reloads the previous output directory and voice or API key edits are lost.
